backend.description: llama.cpp backend; auto = NVIDIA->cuda, AMD/Intel GPU->vulkan, else cpu

llamacpp_release.description: pinned llama.cpp release; must be known to the node (its built-in pin list). Absent = the node's default pin

threads.description: default CPU thread count (set from the benchmark's thread sweep)

default_context_length.description: context length (llama-server -c) for loads that do not ask for one, unless a resident entry or model_context_lengths names one (default: the node's built-in 8192)

max_context_length.description: the largest context per slot the node picks by itself for a load that asks for 'at least' a context (models.load min_context_length); default 32768. The node also never exceeds what the model was trained for

model_context_lengths.description: context length per model name; wins over default_context_length, loses against a residents entry and an explicit models.load argument; {} = none

n_parallel.description: llama-server slots (-np) per model; default 1. The context length of a load is the context of ONE slot (-c = context x slots), so more slots cost KV memory and run long generations side by side; 1-2 suit background and agent use

model_n_parallel.description: slots per model name; wins over n_parallel; {} = none

jinja.description: llama-server --jinja (the model's own chat template engine, needed for native tool calls: OpenAI tools / tool_calls); default true, false = --no-jinja

model_jinja.description: --jinja per model name; wins over jinja; {} = none

model_backends.description: backend and GPU offload per model name (E2-05): e.g. a 7B on vulkan and a 30B on cpu. Absent or {} = the node's backend and llama.cpp's own fit to device memory

backend.description: backend for this model; each needed backend is installed once

gpu_layers.description: exact number of layers on the GPU (0 = none); absent = fit to the free device memory

no_host.description: llama-server --no-host: no pinned host buffers of the GPU backend (an experiment for a partial offload on an iGPU with shared memory; unverified on real hardware)

n_cpu_moe.description: llama-server --n-cpu-moe: the expert weights of the first N layers of a Mixture-of-Experts model stay in the system RAM, the rest runs on the GPU (for a discrete GPU with less VRAM than the model needs); without gpu_layers all other layers go to the GPU without a fit; absent = off; unverified on real hardware

memory_guard.description: RAM check before a load: model + KV cache + overhead against free RAM (a shared iGPU counts as system memory)

mode.description: refuse (default): reject the load with insufficient_memory; warn: load and emit an error event; off

reserve_mb.description: RAM that must stay free after the load; 0 or absent = automatic, the larger of 4096 MB and 12 % of the RAM

allowed_actions.description: whitelist of action names this node may execute

path_prefix.description: folder prefix of the executable path, case-insensitive (e.g. a Steam library)

cooldown_seconds.description: node stays busy_gaming this long after the last watched process ended (default 60)

residents.description: models the node keeps loaded whenever possible (E1-06); reloaded after VRAM pressure or a game when the GPU is free again

priority.description: higher = yielded last and reloaded first (default 50)

auto_reload.description: default true; the hub clears it on a manual unload and sets it again on a manual load

pressure.description: yield VRAM (and optionally RAM) when other programs need it, reload residents when it is free again (E1-06). Absent = disabled; missing fields take the defaults below

enabled.description: GPU VRAM pressure handling (default true when the object is present); only discrete GPUs are watched

sustain_seconds.description: a pressure signal must hold this long before the first model is yielded (default 3)

unload_below_free_mb.description: yield when free VRAM falls below this (default 1024)

margin_mb.description: keep yielding until free VRAM >= unload_below_free_mb + margin_mb (default 1024)

reload_after_seconds.description: reload conditions must hold this long continuously (default 60)

reload_headroom_mb.description: free VRAM needed on top of the model's last measured VRAM to reload it (default 2048)

reload_max_foreign_gpu_util.description: no reload while other programs use more GPU than this, in percent (default 30)

min_off_seconds.description: minimum time between a yield (or game unload) and the next reload (default 120)

reload_while_rule_matches.description: allow reloads while a watcher rule matches or its cooldown runs (default false)

foreign_shared_trigger_mb.description: unmet demand: a single other process using at least this much shared (system) GPU memory while free VRAM is below its shared use + margin_mb counts as pressure (default 1024; 0 = off)

ram.description: same handling on system RAM for models on the CPU backend (default disabled)

unload_below_free_mb.description: yield CPU models when free RAM falls below this (default 2048)

margin_mb.description: keep yielding until free RAM >= unload_below_free_mb + margin_mb (default 1024)

reload_headroom_mb.description: free RAM needed on top of the model's size to reload it (default 1024)

yield.description: stepping back for the person using the machine (E2-05 B, D24). Absent = defaults: freezing is on for a node without a dedicated GPU and off with one; the lowest process priority is always on

enabled.description: freeze the model processes on user input, foreign CPU load or battery power (default: true without a dedicated GPU, false with one)

low_priority.description: run llama-server and llama-bench at the lowest process priority (default true); applies to processes started afterwards

idle_seconds.description: keyboard/mouse input younger than this means the user is here (default 60)

cpu_percent.description: other programs using more than this share of the CPU for sustain_seconds count as load (default 60; 0 = signal off)

sustain_seconds.description: load must hold this long before the node freezes (default 5)

resume_seconds.description: a load pause ends after the load stayed below the threshold this long (default 30)

pause_on_battery.description: freeze while the machine runs on battery (default true; no effect on machines without a battery)

unload_after_pause_seconds.description: a pause this long unloads the models (default 900; 0 = never)

tools.description: read-only capabilities of a tool node (E2-04)

docker_host.description: Docker API: a unix socket or a read-only socket proxy on the loopback (default unix:///var/run/docker.sock)

docker_write_host.description: a second Docker socket proxy that allows only POST /containers/{id}/restart (E3-01b); empty or missing = docker.restart is not offered

shell_socket.description: unix socket of the readshell unit; shell.read (a shell that can only read, as an unprivileged OS user) is offered only where this is set

restart_containers.description: glob patterns of the container names a confirmed proposal may restart; empty or missing = none (default deny)

restart_units.description: glob patterns of the systemd units a confirmed proposal may restart; empty or missing = none (default deny)

connectors_file.description: path of the file on the tool node that holds the credentials of the connector capabilities (Uptime Kuma, Omada); only the path is configured, never the credentials. Default /etc/topcoat-node/connectors.json

compose_roots.description: the only directories compose and .env files are read from or listed; empty or missing releases none (default deny)

searxng_url.description: the SearXNG instance web.search and web.images ask (the json format must be enabled there); empty or missing = neither is offered

private_names.description: names of the operator (hosts, users, domains) that web.search, web.images, web.fetch and web.image refuse to send; the node also refuses its own host name and domain, IP and MAC addresses, e-mail addresses, internal-looking domains and secrets

web_fetch.description: offer web.fetch, which reads public web pages a model names, and web.image, which fetches one picture for a report (private addresses are refused); default false

net_targets.description: the hosts net.check pings (ping) and connects to (ports); configured here, never named by a caller; empty with no dns_names = net.check is not offered

dns_names.description: names net.check resolves with the node's resolver

cert_targets.description: host or host:port (default 443) whose TLS certificate certs.expiry reads; empty = certs.expiry is not offered

docs_roots.description: the only directories the knowledge base reads Markdown and text files from (docs.list, docs.read); empty or missing releases none and the capabilities are not offered (default deny)

read_roots.description: the only directories files.list and files.read look into (HOST-01, D89); empty or missing releases none and the capabilities are not offered (default deny). Not a filesystem root, no UNC or device path. Files whose names mark them as secrets are refused even inside a root

docs_exclude.description: extra globs (matched against every path segment, case-insensitive) added to the fixed exclude list of the knowledge base (*SENSIBEL*, *ZUGANGSDATEN*, *.key, *.pem, *.env, *password*, *secret* …); it never shortens that list

timeout_seconds.description: time limit of one capability call (default 20)

voice.description: the capabilities voice.transcribe (whisper.cpp) and voice.speak (Piper), D127: pinned builds, one process per request, models in <data dir>/voice-models/stt (ggml-*.bin) and tts (*.onnx + *.onnx.json); absent = off

backend.description: whisper.cpp: auto = CUDA on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU, otherwise the CPU (there is no Linux GPU or Vulkan build)

workshop.description: the repo.* capabilities of a dev node (E6-01 S1, D52): where the clones live, which hosts may be cloned from, how tests run. The repositories themselves (URL, branch, token) are never configured here; the hub hands them over with each call

dir.description: absolute directory of the clones; default <data dir>/workshop

allowed_hosts.description: the only hosts a repository URL may name; default github.com

runner.description: how repo.test runs a test template in a throw-away container; none or missing = repo.test is not offered

docker_host.description: unix:///path or tcp://127.0.0.1:port of a Docker (or Podman) API of its own

host_dir.description: the workshop directory as the Docker daemon sees it, when the node itself runs in a container

build-node.description: the Go image repo.build_node cross-builds the node in

browser.description: the image of the browser.* capabilities (deploy/workshop/browser): headless Chromium and its helper

images.description: test template -> image; a template without an image is refused

network.description: Docker network for templates that must download packages; empty = no network

network_templates.description: the templates that may use the network

timeout_seconds.description: hard upper limit of one run: repo.test 600 s by default, a background run (repo.test_start) 1800 s

idle_seconds.description: a background run (repo.test_start) that printed nothing new for this long is ended (default 180)

power.description: energy profile of the node (E2-05 E): what the node itself costs while it has nothing to do

profile.description: performance: nothing is slowed down; balanced (default): polling backs off x3 while nothing is loaded; saver: x6 and the heartbeat x3 while idle

sleep_after_idle_seconds.description: put the machine to sleep after this long without work and without a user (default 0 = never); needs Wake-on-LAN to come back

update.description: update channel of the node (E2-06, D50)

channel.description: the channel whose builds this node may install (default stable)

images.description: the image runner (stable-diffusion.cpp's sd-server, D126): a pinned official build, downloaded when the first image model loads, bound to 127.0.0.1; absent = off

backend.description: default auto; there is no Linux CUDA build, Linux uses vulkan or cpu

model_dirs.description: extra read-only directories with image models (besides <data dir>/image-models)

transfer.description: direct model transfer between nodes (E2-07, D51)

port_min.description: first port the single-use transfer socket may bind (default 47000)

ttl_seconds.description: how long the transfer socket stays open without a finished transfer (default 600)
